Predicates:
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Sees($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x see y?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?

Facts:
Young(Bear, True) ::: The bear is young.
Visits(Bear, Lion, True) ::: The bear visits the lion.
Round(Cat, True) ::: The cat is round.
Needs(Cat, Bear, True) ::: The cat needs the bear.
Cold(Lion, True) ::: The lion is cold.
Green(Lion, False) ::: The lion is not green.
Round(Lion, True) ::: The lion is round.
Needs(Lion, Bear, False) ::: The lion does not need the bear.
Sees(Lion, Bear, True) ::: The lion sees the bear.
Visits(Lion, Bear, True) ::: The lion visits the bear.
Visits(Lion, Cat, True) ::: The lion visits the cat.
Visits(Lion, Rabbit, True) ::: The lion visits the rabbit.
Green(Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit is green.
Rough(Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit is rough.
Sees(Rabbit, Lion, True) ::: The rabbit sees the lion.
Visits(Rabbit, Cat, True) ::: The rabbit visits the cat.

Rules:
Visits($x, Cat, True) >>> Sees(Cat, Lion, True) ::: If something visits the cat then the cat sees the lion.
Visits($x, Lion, True) && Visits(Lion, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs($x, Lion, True) ::: If something visits the lion and the lion visits the rabbit then it needs the lion.
Needs($x, Lion, True) && Round(Lion, True) >>> Needs($x, Cat, True) ::: If something needs the lion and the lion is round then it needs the cat.
Green($x, True) && Needs($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Green(Rabbit, True) ::: If something is green and it needs the rabbit then the rabbit is green.
Round($x, True) >>> Visits($x, Lion, True) ::: If something is round then it visits the lion.
Sees($x, Cat, True) && Visits(Cat, Lion, True) >>> Rough($x, False) ::: If something sees the cat and the cat visits the lion then it is not rough.
Needs($x, Cat, True) && Green($x, False) >>> Sees($x, Cat, True) ::: If something needs the cat and it is not green then it sees the cat.
Young($x, True) && Visits($x, Bear, True) >>> Sees($x, Cat, True) ::: If something is young and it visits the bear then it sees the cat.

Query:
Sees(Lion, Cat, False) ::: The lion does not see the cat.
